scientific_integrity.analytical_basis: Principal-eigenvalue perturbation, exact finite angular Fourier recursion, Descartes positive-root count and rational endpoint certificates.
scientific_integrity.reproducibility: Standalone verify.py reconstructs the polynomial symbolically and checks five finite-dimensional spectral diagnostics.
scientific_integrity.unproved_scope: No extension to finite times, general resetting laws, or robustness of experimental high-order cumulant estimation.

scientific_limitations: The theorem gives the long-time longitudinal sixth-cumulant rate, not finite-time cumulant signs.
Poissonian resetting is instantaneous and changes orientation only; propulsion speed and angular diffusivity are constant and positive.
Added translational Brownian noise is independent and isotropic; arbitrary reset angles, memoryful waiting times, and other active models are outside scope.
A broad additive-functional formula could contain equivalent coefficient representations not detected in the inspected published literature.
title: Exactly two sign reversals of the sixth displacement cumulant under orientational resetting
